summary.value:
The paper presents Stylos, a method for 3D stylization conditioned on a reference style image, applicable to both unposed single-view and multi-view inputs. Stylos builds on the VGGT architecture, leverages 3D Gaussians as the scene representation, and performs style transfer in a single forward pass, achieving competitive visual quality with high efficiency. The initial reviews were very positive, and all reviewers agreed that the paper meets the acceptance bar. Reviewers praised the new capabilities enabled by Stylos and found the empirical results convincing. The minor concerns raised by reviewers were subsequently addressed in the rebuttal.

After carefully considering the paper, reviews, and rebuttal, the AC recommends acceptance.

reviewer_concerns.value: Most reviewers raised only minor concerns, primarily related to empirical validation and technical details. Reviewer Sv2n additionally questioned the technical novelty of Stylos in comparison to Styl3R. These concerns were largely addressed in the rebuttal, which clarified the technical details and presented additional experimental results. In particular, Reviewers Sv2n and LtqC acknowledged during the early discussion phase that their questions and concerns had been satisfactorily resolved.

reviewer_scores.value: The AC expects that all reviewers may maintain or raise their scores, given the reviews and the rebuttal.
